label: Review rejects, records the gap
description: Review returns a non-accepting verdict that is not a change request; reconcile records the shortfall as follow-up work rather than re-executing.
scenario: The acceptance review finds the result falls short in a way the operator does not want re-executed this cycle (out of scope, or better tracked as new work). A plain non-accepting verdict is not changes_requested, so it does not loop back to execute — reconcile still runs and proposes follow-up items so the gap is captured.
